description: A neurology clinic director must assign the clinic's one urgent consultation opening this week among three referrals and finalize the follow-up arrangements for the patients who will not receive that opening, with input from a neurologist, a referral coordinator, and an accessibility coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The neurology clinic has one urgent consultation opening this week, and referrals for Patient A, Patient B, and Patient C are awaiting triage.
shared_context.S2: Marisol makes the final referral-priority and follow-up decisions.
shared_context.S3: All three referrals currently have enough basic information for an administrative triage review.
shared_context.S4: The clinic's routine triage meeting includes the neurologist, referral coordinator, and accessibility coordinator before an urgent opening is assigned.

PF1.text: Dr. Chen reviewed Patient A's outside symptom summary and found repeated episodes of one-sided weakness lasting about 20 minutes; Chen recommends a neurology evaluation within 48 hours and a 60-minute new-patient consultation, but the clinical review has not yet been entered into the referral queue.

PF2.text: Patient B already has a confirmed neurology appointment at Lakeside Medical Center this Friday at 14:00, so the clinic should not consume its urgent opening for B and should record Lakeside as the follow-up site.

PF3.text: Patient C uses American Sign Language and requires a certified ASL interpreter for a 90-minute neurology visit; the interpreter request must be submitted by Wednesday at 12:00 to support the next available routine appointment.

acceptance_conditions: Patient A must receive the urgent consultation opening.
The consultation for Patient A must be scheduled within 48 hours and must be 60 minutes.
Patient B's follow-up must be recorded at Lakeside Medical Center on Friday at 14:00.
Patient C's visit must be planned for 90 minutes.
An ASL interpreter request for Patient C must be logged by Wednesday at 12:00.
The clinical finding supporting Patient A's urgent priority must be cited.

content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'patient_a_consultation' and c['detail'] == '60 minutes' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'interpreter_request' and c['target'] == 'Patient C' and c['detail'] == 'ASL interpreter by Wednesday 12:00' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The documented episodes change Patient A from an undifferentiated referral to the patient requiring evaluation within exactly 48 hours and a 60-minute consultation.
The confirmed Lakeside appointment changes Patient B's follow-up site to Lakeside Medical Center and fixes the follow-up time at Friday 14:00.
Patient C's accessibility requirements change the planned visit duration to exactly 90 minutes and require an ASL interpreter request by Wednesday at 12:00.
